verdict.rationale: Scheduled or background automations are a fair question for a data portal like SAM.gov, for example recurring saved-search alerts, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents on-demand REST APIs, API keys and system accounts, which are building blocks a developer could schedule externally, not a product-provided automation feature. The emailed extract URL is a one-off asynchronous delivery of a single request, not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
